edges.source: Loss of ZNF407 Zinc-Finger Transcription Factor Function

nodes.description: Loss of ZNF407-dependent transcriptional regulation during brain development is proposed to impair neurodevelopment, manifesting as intellectual disability, microcephaly, hypotonia and developmental delay.

evidence.snippet: All affected individuals from families have intellectual disability (ID), ranging from mild to profound, and reduced motor and cognitive skills

nodes.description: ZNF407 is a Kruppel-type C2H2 zinc-finger protein that modulates gene expression by binding DNA. A translocation disrupting the gene reduces ZNF407 expression, and missense variants in the linker regions between zinc-finger structures are predicted to disrupt zinc-finger integrity, together implying loss of ZNF407 transcription-factor function as the molecular mechanism.
